title: Art. 32 — Montreal Convention 1999, Chapter III - Liability of the Carrier and Extent of Compensation for Damage, Article 32 — Death of Person Liable
theme: Liability of the Carrier and Extent of Compensation for Damage
content: In the case of the death of the person liable, an action for damages lies in accordance with the terms of this Convention against those legally representing his or her estate.
